hooks.command: p=$(cat); r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; h="$r/.claude/hooks/block-main-commits.sh"; if [ -r "$h" ]; then printf '%s' "$p" | bash "$h"; else case "$p" in *git*commit*) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"The no-direct-main-commits guard (.claude/hooks/block-main-commits.sh) could not be found, so this commit cannot be judged. Restore it, or drop the hook from .claude/settings.json if it was removed deliberately."}}';; esac; fi

p=$(cat); r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; h="$r/.claude/hooks/guard-local-only.sh"; if [ -r "$h" ] && o=$(printf '%s' "$p" | bash "$h"); then printf '%s' "$o"; else case "$p" in *runtime_governance_state/holdings*|*holdings/holdings_*|*holdings_board*--*) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"The LOCAL_ONLY guard (.claude/hooks/guard-local-only.sh) is missing or failed, so this holdings reference cannot be judged and is refused. Restore the guard, or use docker exec thomas-scheduler python -m scripts.holdings_board."}}';; esac; fi
